summary_en: Foster Electric's wholly owned subsidiary FFEK Co., Ltd. will launch a tender offer for all shares of listed subsidiary ESTec Corporation (Foster owns 49.41%) at a price to be determined, with the offer period from November 11 to December 11, 2026. The goal is to integrate management resources, eliminate parent-subsidiary listing constraints, accelerate decision-making, and maximize synergies, followed by delisting and full consolidation under Korean law.
title_en: Notice Regarding Commencement of Tender Offer for ESTec Corporation (Consolidated Subsidiary) by FFEK Co., Ltd. (Wholly Owned Subsidiary)
translation_en_brief:
Foster Electric Company announced that its wholly owned subsidiary FFEK Co., Ltd. will initiate a tender offer to acquire all shares of ESTec Corporation, a consolidated subsidiary in which Foster currently holds 49.41%. The tender offer period runs from November 11, 2026 to December 11, 2026 (31 days). The offer price was not disclosed in the provided materials.

ESTec Corporation, established in 1999, manufactures and sells automotive speakers and audio equipment for televisions and other applications. The company is listed on Korea's KOSDAQ market, creating a parent-subsidiary listing structure with Foster Electric, which is listed on Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime. The two companies operate in an automotive industry undergoing significant structural transformation due to electrification (xEV) and Software Defined Vehicle (SDV) technologies.

The primary objectives of this transaction are to eliminate constraints inherent in maintaining a parent-subsidiary listing structure, fully integrate the management resources of both companies, accelerate decision-making processes, and maximize potential synergies between the two operations. Following completion of the tender offer, Foster Electric plans to proceed with delisting ESTec and its full consolidation as a subsidiary in accordance with Korean law.
